name: Hair Salon Booking & Payments
descriptor: Rebuilt with the story-driven decomposition methodology — 18 vertical-slice stories across 6 dynamic releases (walking-skeleton-first). Every story cites the requirement it fulfills ( Fulfills: REQ-xxx ), carries Gherkin acceptance that dou

stories.title: A client books an appointment online
stories.story: As a client , I want to pick a service, stylist, and time and book it, so that I get a guaranteed slot in under 3 minutes.
stories.prompt: Build a salon booking page with Cal.com where a client selects a service, stylist, and slot; on confirm, POST to a Supabase appointments row and return a confirmation screen. If the stylist has no slot, show the two nearest alternatives.
acceptance: Happy path — Given the salon has Mia free Tue 2:00pm; When I book "Cut + color with Mia, Tue 2:00pm"; Then the slot is reserved and I see "Booked — Tue 2:00pm with Mia" within 3 minutes.
Stylist unavailable — Given Mia is fully booked Tue; When I try Tue 2:00pm; Then the app offers "Wed 2:00pm with Mia" or "Tue 2:00pm with Jordan".
🛡 Trust — audited — Given I complete a booking; When the slot is reserved; Then the audit log records client_id, action=book, timestamp.

stories.title: Booking confirmation goes out automatically
stories.story: As a client , I want an instant confirmation by SMS and email, so that I trust the booking landed.
stories.owner: Front-Desk Coordinator → Reminder Agent · Release: r0 (wk3)
stories.prompt: On a Supabase insert to appointments, trigger a Make.com scenario that sends a Twilio SMS and a SendGrid email with a reschedule link, then logs the send to audit_log.
acceptance: Confirmation sent — Given I just booked Tue 2:00pm; When the booking saves; Then within 60s I get an SMS + email "Confirmed: Tue 2:00pm with Mia" with a reschedule/cancel link.
AI handles it, no staff — Given the salon has no receptionist online; When I book; Then the confirmation still sends (agent-driven), with no human action.
🛡 Trust — audited — Given a confirmation sends; Then the audit log records channel, recipient, status=sent.

stories.title: An overbooking is held for manager approval
stories.story: As a salon manager , I want any double-booking held for my approval, so that the schedule can't silently overcommit a stylist.
stories.owner: Booking Agent → Trust/Governance Agent · Release: r0 (wk3)
stories.prompt: Build a Retool board listing pending_actions where type='overbook'; an Approve button confirms the appointment and writes an audit_log row with the manager's id; flag rows older than 2 hours red.
acceptance: Hold + approve — Given Mia already has Tue 2:00pm; When a second client books Mia Tue 2:00pm; Then the booking enters the Approval Queue as "pending" and is NOT confirmed until the manager approves.
🛡 Trust — approval audited — Given the manager approves an overbooking; Then the audit log records manager_id, action=approve_overbook, timestamp.
🛡 Trust — stalled approval nudges — Given a pending overbooking sits >2h; Then the manager gets a reminder.

stories.title: Every action writes an audit entry (the trust spine)
stories.story: As a salon owner , I want every booking-related action logged, so that I can always see who did what and when.
stories.prompt: Create a Supabase audit_log table (actor, action, entity, before, after, ts) with row-level security limiting reads to manager/owner roles, and a reusable Make.com module that appends to it.
acceptance: 🛡 Trust — action logged — Given any command fires (book, confirm, approve); When it completes; Then an audit_log row exists with actor, action, before/after, timestamp.
🛡 Trust — authorized-only — Given I am not an owner/manager; When I open the audit log; Then access is denied and the attempt is itself logged.

stories.title: Client pays a deposit at booking
stories.story: As a salon owner , I want clients to pay a deposit when booking, so that no-shows cost them, not me.
stories.prompt: Add a Stripe Checkout step that charges a $25 deposit before confirming the appointment; store the PaymentIntent id in a payments row linked to the appointment; log to audit.
acceptance: Deposit captured — Given a $25 deposit policy; When a client books; Then Stripe charges $25 and the booking shows "Deposit paid — $25".
Reflected in reports — Given a deposit succeeds; Then the payment appears in the day's revenue total.
🛡 Trust — audited — Given a charge succeeds; Then the audit log records amount, stripe_id, status=paid.

stories.title: A failed payment holds the booking
stories.story: As a client , I want to be told immediately if my card fails, so that I can fix it instead of losing the slot silently.
stories.owner: Payment Agent → Front-Desk Coordinator · Release: r1 (wk4)
stories.prompt: On Stripe payment_failed, set the appointment to 'pending', text the client a retry link, and release the slot if still unpaid after 15 minutes.
acceptance: Card declined — Given my card is declined; When I try to book; Then the booking is marked "pending — payment needed" and I get an SMS with a secure retry link.
Slot protected — Given a booking is "pending" for >15 min; Then the slot is released back to availability.
🛡 Trust — audited — Given a payment fails; Then the audit log records status=failed and the reason.

stories.title: Refunds require manager approval
stories.story: As a salon manager , I want refunds to need my approval, so that money never leaves without a human check.
stories.owner: Payment Agent → Trust/Governance Agent · Release: r1 (wk4)
stories.prompt: Add refund requests to the existing Approval Queue; on approve, call Stripe refunds.create for the deposit and audit it; on deny, notify the client.
acceptance: Refund held — Given a client requests a refund; When the request is made; Then it enters the Approval Queue and no money moves until I approve.
🛡 Trust — approve → refund — Given I approve; Then Stripe refunds the deposit and the audit log records manager_id, action=approve_refund, amount.
Deny → kept — Given I deny; Then no refund occurs and the client is notified with the reason.

stories.title: Alternatives when the stylist is unavailable
stories.story: As a client , I want smart alternatives when my stylist is full, so that I still book today.
stories.prompt: When the chosen stylist has no slot, query their next two openings plus one skill-matched stylist the same day, and show why each was suggested.
acceptance: Nearest times — Given Mia is full Tue; When I request Tue; Then I'm offered Mia's next 2 openings + 1 other qualified stylist same day.
Respect skills — Given I want "balayage"; Then only stylists who offer balayage are suggested.
🛡 Trust — explainable — Then suggestions are explainable ("offered because Mia is full; Jordan also does balayage").

stories.title: Real-time two-way calendar sync
stories.story: As a stylist , I want bookings to appear on my Google Calendar instantly, so that I never double-book myself elsewhere.
stories.prompt: Wire Cal.com two-way Google Calendar sync; on sync error, retry 3 times then send the stylist a Twilio alert and log it.
acceptance: Push within seconds — Given a new booking; When it confirms; Then it appears on the stylist's Google Calendar within 30s.
Sync-fail safety — Given the sync API errors; Then the system retries 3× and alerts the stylist if still failing.
🛡 Trust — audited — Then sync attempts and failures are logged.

stories.title: Automated 24h and 1h reminders
stories.story: As a client , I want reminders before my visit, so that I don't forget.
stories.prompt: Schedule a Make.com job that finds appointments 24h and 1h out and sends a reminder with a reschedule link, logging each send.
acceptance: Two reminders — Given a confirmed appointment; When it is 24h and again 1h away; Then I get an SMS/email with a reschedule/cancel link.
🛡 Trust — audited — Then each reminder send is logged with status.

stories.title: Auto-cancel unpaid no-shows + rebook offer
stories.story: As a salon owner , I want unpaid no-shows auto-cancelled and the slot offered to the waitlist, so that I recover lost revenue.
stories.owner: Reminder Agent → Trust/Governance Agent · Release: r3 (wk7–8)
stories.prompt: Detect unpaid appointments 15 min past start with no check-in; queue an auto-cancel for manager approval; on approve, release the slot and text the next waitlisted client.
acceptance: Grace then hold — Given an unpaid booking is 15 min past start with no check-in; When the grace lapses; Then an auto-cancel is proposed to the Approval Queue (manager-gated).
🛡 Trust — approve → release + rebook — Given the manager approves; Then the slot is released and the top waitlist client is offered it by SMS.
🛡 Trust — audited — Then the auto-cancel decision and approval are logged.

stories.title: Reminder/confirmation send-failures self-heal
stories.story: As a salon owner , I want failed messages retried and logged, so that a silent Twilio outage doesn't cause a no-show.
stories.prompt: Wrap the reminder send in a retry (2×/10 min); if it still fails, log failed_final and alert the front desk.
acceptance: Retry — Given a send fails; When the error returns; Then the system retries 2× over 10 min before flagging it.
🛡 Trust — visible failure — Given all retries fail; Then the audit log shows status=failed_final and the front desk is alerted.

stories.title: Stylist sees a color-coded schedule
stories.story: As a stylist , I want my day color-coded by status, so that I see confirmed vs. pending at a glance.
stories.prompt: Build a Retool day/week calendar reading appointments for the logged-in stylist, colored by status.
acceptance: Confirmed vs pending — Given a mix of bookings; When I open my day; Then confirmed = green, pending = amber, cancelled = grey.
🛡 Trust — audited read — Given I open another stylist's day; Then access is limited to my own unless I'm a manager (logged).

stories.title: Capture client preferences into the profile
stories.story: As a client , I want the salon to remember my stylist and services, so that rebooking is one tap.
stories.prompt: On visit completion, append the stylist, service, and date to the client's profile; give clients a page to view/delete their stored preferences.
acceptance: Learn on visit — Given I complete a visit with Mia for balayage; Then my profile stores Mia + balayage + date.
🛡 Trust — consented — Given preferences are stored; Then I can view and delete them (transparency/consent), and the change is logged.

stories.title: Personalized rebooking suggestions
stories.story: As a returning client , I want a one-tap "your usual", so that booking takes seconds.
stories.prompt: If a client has visit history, prefill the booking with their most frequent stylist+service and show the next opening; otherwise show the normal flow.
acceptance: Your usual — Given I have a history with Mia; When I open the app; Then I see "Rebook your usual — cut + color with Mia?" with her next opening.
Cold-start fallback — Given I have no history; Then I see the standard flow (no broken personalization).

stories.title: Post-visit thank-you + feedback request
stories.story: As a salon owner , I want a thank-you + feedback ask after each visit, so that I build loyalty and catch problems early.
stories.prompt: 24h after a visit, send a thank-you with a 1–5 rating link; store the rating on the profile; nudge once at 48h if no response.
acceptance: Thank-you in 24h — Given a completed visit; When 24h passes; Then the client gets a thank-you + 1-tap rating link; the response saves to their profile.
Gentle nudge — Given no response after 48h; Then one (and only one) reminder is sent.

stories.title: Trust dashboard (health + recent actions)
stories.story: As a salon owner , I want one screen of system health + recent actions, so that I can trust the AI workforce at a glance.
stories.prompt: Build a Retool dashboard showing pending approvals, the last 20 audit entries, failed message sends, and anomalies; escalate unacknowledged anomalies after 1h.
acceptance: Live view — Given I open the dashboard; Then I see pending approvals, last 20 audited actions, failed sends, and any anomalies.
🛡 Trust — escalation — Given an anomaly is unacknowledged for 1h; Then it escalates to an SMS to the owner.

stories.title: Governance score with threshold alerts
stories.story: As a salon owner , I want a single governance score, so that I know the system is operating within its trust rules.
stories.prompt: Compute a governance score from audit-coverage, approval-honored rate, and failed-send rate; if below 80, surface the top contributing failure and a recommended fix.
acceptance: Real-time score — Given actions occur; Then a 0–100 governance score updates from % actions audited, % approvals honored, failed-send rate.
🛡 Trust — below threshold → recommend — Given the score drops below 80; Then the dashboard recommends a specific corrective action (e.g. "3 overbookings bypassed approval — review agent rules").

stories.title: 📌 START HERE — Documents & how to read this plan
acceptance: 📄 Requirements & REQ Catalog (split by capability cluster) — the 12 REQ-### requirements, grouped into the clusters the generator slices stories from.
📄 Agent Map & Architecture (multi-agent + TBI) — the 6 agents, bounded contexts, data model, and trust design.
📄 Traceability Matrix (RTM) + gate result — every requirement ⇄ its covering stories; gate = 8/8 must-haves covered → PASS.
